dialogue.origin: こんにちは相談員です。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.origin: 最初に年齢と性別を教えていただいてもいいですか？
dialogue.content: To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 40代女性です
dialogue.content: I'm a woman in my 40s.

dialogue.origin: お返事ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 夫の家族の相続問題で悩んでいます。
dialogue.content: I'm struggling with an inheritance issue in my husband's family.

dialogue.origin: 相続問題ですね。なかなか難しそうですね。話せるところから、お話しいただけますか？
dialogue.content: An inheritance issue, I see. That can be quite complicated. Could you start from wherever you feel comfortable?

dialogue.origin: はい、義父が住んでいる持ち家を譲ってもらう予定でいたのですが、夫と義父が揉めてその話がなくなってしまいそうなんです。
dialogue.content: Yes. We were supposed to inherit the house my father-in-law lives in, but my husband and he had a disagreement, and now it seems like that plan might fall through.

dialogue.origin: それはあなたにとっても大問題ですね。
dialogue.content: That must be a big problem for you as well.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。
dialogue.content: Yes, it is.

dialogue.origin: どういう経緯でそういうことになりそうなのですか？
dialogue.content: How did this situation come about?

dialogue.origin: 些細なことで、義父から夫に相続についての話をするために電話があったみたいなんですがその際に、夫は仕事中だったためちゃんと話を聞けなかったらしく、その様子に義父が腹を立てて「あの話は無しだ」とまで言っていて。
dialogue.content: It was over something trivial. It seems my father-in-law called my husband to talk about the inheritance, but my husband was at work and couldn't listen properly. My father-in-law got angry about that and went as far as to say, 'The deal is off.'

dialogue.origin: そんな些細なことで、そうなってしまうとは・・・
dialogue.content: For something so minor to escalate like that...

dialogue.origin: はい、困ってしまいました
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm at a loss.

dialogue.origin: あなたとしても、いろいろ考えていらしたでしょうに・・・ところで、義理のお父様はおいくつなのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You must have had many plans as well... By the way, how old is your father-in-law?

dialogue.origin: 70代です。
dialogue.content: He's in his 70s.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。まだ相続のことを考えるには少しお若いような気もするのですが、お体的にそろそろ相続のことを考えなければならないご事情とかおありなのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. It seems a bit on the early side to be thinking about inheritance, but are there any health-related or other reasons that make it necessary to consider it now?

dialogue.origin: 義母はすでに他界していて、かなり広い家に今1人住まいしているんです。それが不便なのと体も少し悪くなってきているようで、自分はもう老人ホームに入るから、とのことです。家を私たち家族でゆずり受けること自体は結構前から決まっていました。
dialogue.content: My mother-in-law has already passed away, and he's living alone in a rather large house. It's becoming inconvenient for him, and his health seems to be declining a bit, so he says he's going to move into a nursing home. The plan for our family to inherit the house had been decided for quite some time.

dialogue.origin: そういうご事情だったのですね。義理のお父様は老人ホームで安心して過ごしたい、ついてはご実家はあなたがたご一家にゆずりたいということですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's the situation. Your father-in-law wants to live comfortably in a nursing home, and in turn, he wanted to pass the family home on to your family.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、夫さんには、相続を一緒に考えなければならない、ご兄弟とか、姉妹さんとははいらっしゃらないのですか？
dialogue.content: By the way, does your husband have any siblings who would also need to be involved in these inheritance discussions?

dialogue.origin: 夫には妹がいて家庭を持っています。義妹と義父はかなり前に揉めたらしく今は疎遠で、相続の話には関与していないです。
dialogue.content: My husband has a younger sister who has her own family. Apparently, she and my father-in-law had a falling out a long time ago and are now estranged, so she isn't involved in the inheritance discussions.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、義理のお父様から電話がお仕事中の夫さんに入って、相続のことが雲行きがあやしくなったのは、どのくらい前のことですか？
dialogue.content: Just to clarify, how long ago was it that your father-in-law called your husband at work and the inheritance situation became uncertain?

dialogue.origin: おとといです、、おととい電話で揉め、昨日直接話してきました。
dialogue.content: It was the day before yesterday. They argued on the phone the day before yesterday, and we went to talk to him in person yesterday.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。大きな問題ですものね、直接話されたんですね。昨日の義理のお父様と夫さんとの話はどんな様子でしたか？
dialogue.content: I see. It's a significant issue, so you spoke in person. How did the conversation between your father-in-law and your husband go yesterday?

dialogue.origin: それがまともな話し合いにならなかったというか…
dialogue.content: It didn't really turn into a proper discussion...

dialogue.origin: 義父の家で話したのですが、かなり怒っていたので、私が子供を連れて夫抜きで最初お邪魔したんです。
dialogue.content: We talked at my father-in-law's house, but he was very angry, so I first went with my children, without my husband.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。そうしたら・・・
dialogue.content: I see. And then...?

dialogue.origin: 電話の件はこんな風に誤解があったんですよと説明し、一通り聞いてくれたので夫を登場させたのですが、そこからは怒りが再燃したようまともに話ができませんでした。
dialogue.content: I explained that there was a misunderstanding about the phone call, and he seemed to listen. So, I had my husband come in, but from that point on, his anger flared up again, and we couldn't talk properly.

dialogue.origin: 再燃したようで、まともに、です
dialogue.content: It flared up again, so we couldn't talk properly.

dialogue.origin: それは大変でしたね。義理のお父様は一体何に怒こっていらしたのですか？
dialogue.content: That must have been very difficult. What exactly was your father-in-law angry about?

dialogue.origin: 電話の内容が相続税を安くする方法を見つけたという良い報告だったらしく、にも関わらずそれをないがしろにした、せっかく色々調べたのにお前たちは何を考えてるんだ！？って感じです
dialogue.content: Apparently, the phone call was to share good news—that he had found a way to reduce the inheritance tax. He felt that my husband disregarded it, and his attitude was like, 'I went to all this trouble to research this, and you don't care?! What are you thinking?!'

dialogue.origin: そこまで怒ることか、と夫婦では話してるのですが、元々頑固で怒りっぽいところはあって。
dialogue.content: My husband and I have been talking about whether it's something to get so angry over, but he has always been stubborn and quick to anger.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: それはお困りですね。
dialogue.content: That must be troubling.

dialogue.origin: 義理のお父様の性格的な面もあるようですね・・・
dialogue.content: It seems your father-in-law's personality plays a part in this...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですよね、一度言ったことは曲げない、みたいなところもあるので、もしかしたら本当に話が無しになってしまうかもと恐れています
dialogue.content: That's right. He also has a tendency to never go back on his word, so I'm afraid the deal might really be off.

dialogue.origin: 義理のお父様がご自分で節税のことなどお考えになってくれている所を見ると、かなりまじめでまっすぐな方のようですね。
dialogue.content: Seeing that your father-in-law took the initiative to look into tax savings for you, he seems like a very earnest and straightforward person.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、真面目で一直線！って感じです
dialogue.content: Yes—earnest and single-minded! That’s exactly it.

dialogue.origin: そんな方が、万一考えを変えてしまうと、軌道修正するのにかなり大変そうですね。あなたご心配もごもっともと感じますよ・・・
dialogue.content: With someone like that, if he changes his mind, it could be quite difficult to get things back on track. I completely understand your concern.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです、夫は転職までして地元に戻ってきて、今義父の家の近くの賃貸に住んでいるのですが、その話がなくなるとなるとこの先どうしようかと。
dialogue.content: That's right. My husband even changed jobs so we could move back to our hometown, and we're currently renting near my father-in-law's house. If this falls through, I'm not sure what we'll do going forward.

dialogue.origin: あなた方ご一家はそこまでなさってこられたんですね。
dialogue.content: So your family has gone to such lengths.

dialogue.origin: 義理のお父さんの側にいてあげようという思いで、転職なさって地元に戻って来られたような気がしますが・・・
dialogue.content: It sounds like your husband changed jobs and you moved back out of a desire to be there for your father-in-law...

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね。何かあった時に、という思いもありました。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right. We also wanted to be there in case anything happened.

dialogue.origin: 義理のお父さん思いですね・・・
dialogue.content: That's very thoughtful of you toward your father-in-law...

dialogue.origin: 夫の想いでもあります、元々の親子関係は良好なので、、
dialogue.content: It's my husband's wish as well—their relationship has always been good...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。親子関係が良いのはとっても大事な事ですね。ところがこんな具合になってしまって、心配ですね・・・夫さんは、昨日は家に帰って来てから、何か仰っていましたか？
dialogue.content: I see. A good parent-child relationship is so important. It must be worrying that things have turned out this way... Did your husband say anything after he came home yesterday?

dialogue.origin: こりゃだめだと、今は何も話せないということと、本当に話がなくなった場合のことを決めないとね、って感じでした。疲れ果ててはいます。
dialogue.content: He basically said, 'This is hopeless, we can't talk to him right now,' and that we need to decide what to do if the plan is truly off. He's completely exhausted.

dialogue.origin: お二人とも昨日は相当お疲れになってしまったのですね・・・
dialogue.content: Both of you must have been quite exhausted yesterday...

dialogue.origin: ここまでのところを、少し整理させていただいてもいいですか？
dialogue.content: May I summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.origin: お願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 義理の父は70代。義理の母は他界しているので、実家で独り暮らしをしている。
dialogue.content: Your father-in-law is in his 70s. Since your mother-in-law passed away, he's been living alone in the family home.

dialogue.origin: 夫はそんな父親の側にいてあげようと、転職までして、地元に一家で戻ってきて、実家の近くに借家住まいをしている。
dialogue.content: Your husband, wanting to be there for his father, even changed jobs and moved the family back to his hometown, and you're now renting a place near the family home.

dialogue.origin: 義理の父はそのうち自分は老人ホームに入り、実家は私たち一家に譲ると言ってくれていた。
dialogue.content: Your father-in-law had said that he would eventually move into a nursing home and pass the family home on to your family.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ところが、おととい、義理の父が会社の夫に電話を入れた時、夫は仕事中のため事務的な返事をしたらしく、そのため、義理のお父さんはすっかり怒ってしまった。
dialogue.content: However, the day before yesterday, when your father-in-law called your husband at work, your husband was busy and apparently gave a business-like response, which made your father-in-law very angry.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 昨日一家で実家に行きぎりのお父さんとお話をしたが、お父さんとしては相続税を安くする方法を見つけたので相談したかったとのこと。ところが、その話を十分聞いてもらえなかったので怒ってしまったようだ。
dialogue.content: Yesterday, your family went to speak with him, and it seems he was angry because he wanted to discuss a method he'd found to lower the inheritance tax, but he felt he wasn't heard out.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 昨日は義理のお父さんの怒りが収まらず、夫婦そろって困ってしまっている。
dialogue.content: Yesterday, your father-in-law's anger didn't subside, leaving both you and your husband at a loss.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: そこで、あなたとしては、これからお父さん対応について、どのようにして行ったらいいか、何かお考えはおありですか？
dialogue.content: With that in mind, do you have any thoughts on how you would like to handle the situation with your father-in-law moving forward?

dialogue.origin: 夫と義父が元の関係に戻って、相続を無事に受けられるようになってほしいという思いです。が、どうアプローチしていけばいいかが見えず…悩んでいます。
dialogue.content: I want my husband and father-in-law to return to their previous relationship and for the inheritance to proceed smoothly. But I don't see how to approach it, and I'm struggling with that.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 私の考えをお伝えしてもいいですか？
dialogue.content: May I share my thoughts?

dialogue.origin: はい、ぜひお願いします。
dialogue.content: Yes, please do.

dialogue.origin: ポイントは２つあると思います。
dialogue.content: I think there are two key points.

dialogue.origin: ２つですか。
dialogue.content: Two points?

dialogue.origin: はい　ひとつずつよろしいですか。ポイント1　もともとお父さんと夫さんは仲の良い親子だったとのことです。
dialogue.content: Yes, one at a time, if that's okay. Point 1: You mentioned that your husband and his father originally had a good relationship.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そこで、義理のお父さん対応は、息子である夫さんに前面に出ていただく。
dialogue.content: Therefore, I suggest having your husband, as the son, take the lead in communicating with his father.

dialogue.origin: 多分　長い間培った親子の信頼関係でやがて、氷の解けるひが来るかと思います。
dialogue.content: I believe that with the trust they've built as father and son over many years, the ice will eventually thaw.

dialogue.origin: ポイント２義理のお父さんは、義理のお母さんが亡くなってから一人暮らしだったと思います。
dialogue.content: Point 2: Your father-in-law has been living alone since your mother-in-law passed away.

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 多分話し相手なく、過ごして来られて、まじめな方なので、とにかく誰かに話しを聴いてもらいたかったという思いが心の奥にあるのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: He probably hasn't had many people to talk to, and being an earnest person, I wonder if deep down he just really wanted someone to listen to him.

dialogue.origin: そこで、当分、賛成も反対もせず、とにかくお父さんの考えを、拝聴させていただくというスタンスで臨んでみると、お父さんとしては、十分に話を聞いてもらえると、内容は別にして、とにかく聞いてもらったということで心が軽くなるかもしれません。
dialogue.content: So, for the time being, if you approach him with the stance of simply listening to his thoughts—without agreeing or disagreeing—he might feel relieved just by being heard, regardless of the content.

dialogue.origin: という2つの考えなのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Those are my two thoughts. How do they sound to you?

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれないですね、、よく遊びには行っていたのですが、もっと話をしたいという思いがあったのかもしれないですね。
dialogue.content: That could be true... We visited him often, but maybe he wanted to talk more.

dialogue.origin: かもしれません。まじめな方なだけに、父親らしくしていなければ・・・と態度を作っていたのかもしれないという気がするのですが・・・
dialogue.content: Perhaps. Precisely because he is so earnest, he may have felt he had to act 'like a father,' so to speak.

dialogue.origin: ほとぼりが冷めるのを待って、義父自身がもっと楽になってもらえるような、関わり方にしていけたらと思います。
dialogue.content: I'd like to wait for things to cool down and then find a way of interacting with him that helps him feel more at ease.

dialogue.origin: ステキですね。それがいいと思います。急がずに、じっくりと・・・
dialogue.content: That’s wonderful. I think that’s a good approach. No need to rush—take your time...

dialogue.origin: ところで、もう一つだけ申し上げたほうが良いかなと思うことがあるので言ってもいいですか？
dialogue.content: By the way, may I mention one more thing that I think might be helpful?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: はい、お願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: 義理の妹さんのことです。
dialogue.content: It’s about your sister-in-law.

dialogue.origin: 法律的には義理の妹さんにも相続の遺留分があるかと思います。
dialogue.content: Legally, I believe your sister-in-law is entitled to a reserved share of the inheritance.

dialogue.origin: その辺の、法律的な面は、しっかり市役所の相続関係法律相談などで確認されておかれると安心かと思います。
dialogue.content: It might give you peace of mind to confirm the legal aspects of this through an inheritance legal consultation at your city hall or a similar service.

dialogue.origin: 相続をしないという話が義父と義妹間で話されていると聞いているのですが、何かあって後から揉めても困りますもんね…改めて確認してみます。
dialogue.content: I heard that my father-in-law and sister-in-law have already discussed her not inheriting anything, but it would be troublesome if issues arose later... I will confirm this again.

dialogue.origin: そうなさってみてください。
dialogue.content: Please do.

dialogue.origin: 何か気になることが出てきたらまたご相談にいらしてください。ご一緒に考えさせていただきます。
dialogue.content: If anything else comes up that concerns you, please feel free to come back and talk. We can think it through together.

dialogue.origin: はい。今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Okay. Thank you very much for today.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、ご相談にいらしてくださりありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in to talk with me today.

dialogue.origin: またお世話になる際はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: If I need help again, I hope I can count on you.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、その時はまたよろしくお願いいたします。では、今日はこの辺で失礼いたします。
dialogue.content: Of course, I'll be here for you. Well then, we'll end here for today.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

topic.sub: 義父との相続問題に関する対立
